title: Boss: The Coin Snake
story: A snake of corridors with coins on every bend. Collect all the coins in as few actions as you can.
goal: Reach the flag with every coin, in at most 40 actions.
hints: Combine the two ideas: pick coins, and follow the path.
Check the coin first, then choose where to go.
socratic: What should the parrot do at each step?
What does the parrot need to look at before it moves?
Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does your code decide what to do next?
